oracleRisk.summary: Chancery direct issuance and redemption use configured deposit_rate_e9 and redeem_rate_e9 values. Privileged asset-configuration updates can change these rates subject to program controls. These are internal settlement-price authorities, not independent market-price oracles or borrower liquidation feeds.

branchApplicability.rationale: The replacement mint settles approved counterparties against configured reserve assets at administrator-configured rates. Its reviewed path has no borrower-owned collateral positions or oracle-triggered liquidation branches. Internal settlement rates remain a price-sensitive control even when configured at par.
